scope: Temporary SQLite files only on one observed cloud host; no product writer, user database or operational qualification

observedEnvironment.procVersion: Linux version 6.18.44-fc-v37 (builder@sandboxing) (gcc (GCC) 15.3.0, GNU ld (GNU Binutils) 2.46) #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC @0
observedEnvironment.kernelKind: real Linux kernel in a Firecracker/KVM microVM (dmesg: 'Hypervisor detected: KVM', kvm-clock, rdinit=/process_api --firecracker-init; root /dev/vda ext4; no gVisor markers)
observedEnvironment.containerMarkers: systemd-detect-virt reported 'docker' but /.dockerenv is absent and every /proc/1/cgroup entry is '/'; treated as a sandbox host, not an operational Linux host

mechanism.connectionOwner: python3 -I process that loads the system libsqlite3.so.0 through ctypes and owns the sqlite3 connection
mechanism.open: sqlite3_open_v2(SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE, vfs 'unix') opens an existing temporary main DB without CREATE
mechanism.openedFileIdentity: Before open, the default unix VFS (checked zName 'unix', iVersion >= 3) gets documented xSetSystemCall overrides for 'open' and 'close' that forward to the originals from xGetSystemCall. The fd returned inside SQLite's own xOpen for the main DB path is recorded, closes of that fd clear it, and exactly one live main open is required. identity = fstat(fd) st_dev:st_ino as 16+16 hex digits
mechanism.comparison: Expected ID is mandatory for schema write and checked before SQLite is loaded; a mismatch closes the connection without running any SQL (exit 2)
mechanism.firstWritePosition: Only a matched identity reaches sqlite3_exec(CREATE TABLE probe_marker); replacement and copy-restore fixtures keep their bytes and leave no resource.sqlite3 sidecar
mechanism.raceAfterOpen: A fixture-only hook (B14PL_SWAP_AFTER_OPEN) renames the path to another inode after SQLite opened it; the comparison still matches the opened inode and the schema lands in that inode, while the new file at the path stays empty. A path-based stat mutant fails this case
mechanism.notIdentityEvidence: The isfile check only limits probe input to an existing OS-temp file. No separate guard FD, path stat or DatabaseSync(path) is used as identity

installedShapeObserved.nativeRuntime: System python3 (ctypes) and system libsqlite3.so.0; no probe-owned native binary and no compiler at run time. The loaded library path is reported from /proc/self/maps, not verified against a trusted location
installedShapeObserved.probeScriptLocation: Copied into an unprotected test temp directory; no signed or protected installation was tested
installedShapeObserved.invocation: Node.js run.mjs starts python3 -I probe.py, which owns the SQLite connection and returns identity/status as JSON
installedShapeObserved.sidecarNaming: Rollback-journal sidecars are named from the path SQLite was given, not from the opened inode; in the race fixture the journal is created and removed at resource.sqlite3-journal

check.observed: 1 test: installed two-file copy without node_modules; empty expected ID blocks schema write; SQLite xOpen fd identity equals the path inode before any change; matched identity permits schema write; rename replacement and byte-identical copy restore reject before schema write with bytes and sidecar list unchanged; moving the original inode back matches; post-open path swap keeps comparison and write on the opened inode
falsification: Mutant skipping the identity comparison: FAIL
Mutant using path stat instead of the SQLite fd: FAIL
Mutant not recording the xOpen fd: FAIL
Mutant dropping the expected-ID requirement: FAIL
check.straceCrossCheck: Manual strace -f of one race run: the only openat of the DB path was SQLite's O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC open returning fd 3 (the fd the probe reported); after the swap the journal was opened and unlinked at <path>-journal

unobservedMatrix: Operational Linux hosts with systemd PID1, non-root principals or other kernels
Node 24 and GitHub Ubuntu CI runners
Other libsqlite3 builds, including builds without the unix VFS system-call interface or with a different default VFS
Node's bundled node:sqlite, which does not expose the VFS or its fd; this probe does not cover it
notEstablished: Operational expected-ID provenance or writer/worker OS-principal separation
Protected provenance of python3, probe.py and libsqlite3 in an operational install; a same-principal worker can replace them or preload code
Sidecar, alias, restart, crash and adversarial race controls required for a product writer
Any Linux support claim from the Windows B14-p probe; this evidence is independent of it
Qualification beyond this Firecracker/KVM sandbox host
